omittedAssetPaths.reason: Upstream docs/asset-policy.md states this format table is not covered by the repository licence. Leonida integration requires user-supplied external tables.

integrationStatement: Vendored and integrated locally into tudorek12345/Leonida. This is not an upstream endorsement.

localChanges.purpose: Load user-supplied BCPack format tables without redistributing the upstream non-licensed blob. Preserve the builtin() call API, validate the external source boundary and bound file reads; test missing, malformed and synthetic valid files.
Remove the omitted table exception from tracking and asset checks; document the external-file requirement.
Refuse hook installation into the parent Git repository and scope both working-tree and staged policy checks to the vendored subtree, with temporary-repository tests.
Keep current-executable PE probes on Windows and add hand-written synthetic PE parser/import coverage for other hosts.
Remove the upstream trailing blank line so the imported patch passes git diff --check; table content is unchanged.
